page one · mushy stuff

For my babyyy, 💌

Happy Birthday, My Babyyyy, My Jannuuu, My Loveee, My Everything! 🎂❤️🧸💗 Jab se aap aaye ho meri life mein, tab se main bas happy rahi hoon. 🥹💕 Idk main kab last time yeh soch ke royi hongi ki “Yeh ladka mujhe achha treat nahi karta.” Baby, aap meri life mein kaash pehle aa jaate, mujhe itne saare gande ladke nahi milte. 😭❤️ Aapke saath bitaya har pal ek sapne sa hai. 🥹✨ Kon itna pyaar kar sakta hai kisi ko? Bilkul filmy pyaar karte ho aap mere se! 🎬💗 Aapse door jaane ka soch bhi nahi sakti main. 🫂❤️ Apna milna college mein, woh talking stage, apni hayeee! 😭💘 Woh toh kabhi bhool hi nahi sakti main. Aapse kab itna pyaar ho jaayega, socha hi nahi tha maine. 🥹💕 Talking stage mein aapki villain-type personality se itni attractive ho gayi thi main. 😭💕 Ek alag sa hi attachment tha! Woh pehli baar apna CAMD ki class mein milna, mera woh small-scale maangna, aapka us time blush karna 🙈❤️, mujhe WhatsApp pe text karna, mera aapse sab share karna, aapki woh thodi-thodi si jealousy, uff! 😭🤭💗 Mera har cheez mein aapko text karna, aapka mujhe class mein dekhna... 🥹💕 Sab ek sapna sa lagta hai. Sochti hoon tab ki yeh toh movies mein hota haiii! 🎬✨❤️ Honestly, Babyyy, main jitna batati nahi hoon, but main aapse bahut pyaar karti hoon, khud se bhi zyada. 🥹❤️ Main bas aisa show karti hoon ki mujhe farak nahi padhta, but aapse mujhe bahut farak padhta hai, Babyyy. 🫶🏻💗 Aapka good morning nahi aata toh achhi subah nahi hoti meri. 🌅🥺 Kuch incomplete sa lagta hai. 💌 I love yuhh so so muchh! ❤️🧸 Bahut zyada pyaar karti hoon, words mein nahi bata sakti kitna karti hoon. 🥹💋 Chhod ke mat jaana mujhe kabhiii! 🥺🫂❤️ Kisne bola yeh birthday achha nahi banega aapka? Itna pyaara note bheja hai maine aapko! 😭💌💗 Just imagine karo, kuch time baad aap dono saath mein honge... Aapke birthday ke din candles hongi, room mein dim-dim lights hongi, aur pyaara sa song play ho raha hoga... 🎂🕯️✨💗 Ya 12 baje ki clock hogi, aur main aapki god mein baith ke aapko Happy Birthday wish kar rahi hongi, aur phir pyaari si kiss... 🙈💋❤️ Bas bas haan, aap gir mat jaana, jahan bhi ho udhar se! 😭😂🤭 I know blush aa gaya hoga! Mera bhi aa raha hai type karte-karte, Babyyy! 🙈💗🫣 Aap best ho mere liye. ❤️ Kabhi yeh mat sochna ki main kaise mil gayi. Main toh yeh sochti hoon ki aap kaise mil gaye mujhe, jo meri itni care karte ho, mujhse itna pyaar karte ho. 🥹🫶🏻💖 Once again, Babyyy, Happyyy Birthdayyyy, Meri Jannnnn! 🎂🎉❤️😘💋💗
Forever your partner-in-crime, ♡
